args <- commandArgs(TRUE)
repo <- args[[1L]]
root <- args[[2L]]
control <- args[[3L]]
candidate <- args[[4L]]
filter <- readRDS(args[[5L]])
manifest_path <- file.path(repo,"tests/testdata/workflow-execution/qualification.json")
manifest <- jsonlite::read_json(manifest_path)
primary <- manifest$cases$primary
sha <- function(path) digest::digest(file=path,algo="sha256")
stopifnot(identical(sha(file.path(primary$store_directory,"dia-state-head.rds")), primary$source_head_sha256))
plan <- list(schema=1L, goal="integration_non_regression", source_manifest=sha(manifest_path),
    test_sha256=sha(file.path(repo,"tests/testthat/test-workflow-execution-adapters.R")),
    helper_sha256=sha(file.path(repo,"tests/testthat/helper-workflow-bulk-rollup.R")),
    libraries=list(control=list(path=control,sha256=sha(file.path(control,"MultiScholaR/R/MultiScholaR.rdb"))),
        candidate=list(path=candidate,sha256=sha(file.path(candidate,"MultiScholaR/R/MultiScholaR.rdb")))),
    policy=manifest$resource_policy, members=list(), promotion_authorized=FALSE)
for (cell in c("filter","primary")) for (i in 1:4) {
    arm <- c("control","candidate","candidate","control")[[i]]
    rep <- c(1L,1L,2L,2L)[[i]]
    id <- paste(cell,arm,rep,sep="-")
    path <- file.path(root,id)
    stopifnot(!dir.exists(path));dir.create(path)
    input <- if (cell=="filter") filter else list(source_store=primary$store_directory,
        source_head_sha256=primary$source_head_sha256,input_entity_id=primary$reference$entity_id,parameters=list())
    request <- c(list(schema=1L,cell=cell,arm=arm,rep=rep,manifest_sha256=plan$source_manifest),input)
    saveRDS(request,file.path(path,"timed-member.rds"))
    plan$members[[length(plan$members)+1L]] <- list(id=id,cell=cell,arm=arm,rep=rep,
        root=path,request_sha256=sha(file.path(path,"timed-member.rds")),library=plan$libraries[[arm]])
}
saveRDS(plan,file.path(root,"comparison-plan.rds"))
jsonlite::write_json(plan,file.path(root,"comparison-plan.json"),auto_unbox=TRUE,pretty=TRUE)

args <- commandArgs(TRUE)
plan <- readRDS(args[[1L]])
member <- Filter(function(x) identical(x$id,args[[2L]]),plan$members)[[1L]]
repo <- args[[3L]]
sha <- function(path) digest::digest(file=path,algo="sha256")
stopifnot(identical(sha(file.path(member$library$path,"MultiScholaR/R/MultiScholaR.rdb")),member$library$sha256),
    identical(sha(file.path(member$root,"timed-member.rds")),member$request_sha256),
    identical(sha(file.path(repo,"tests/testthat/test-workflow-execution-adapters.R")),plan$test_sha256),
    identical(sha(file.path(repo,"tests/testthat/helper-workflow-bulk-rollup.R")),plan$helper_sha256))
.libPaths(c(member$library$path,.libPaths()))
ns <- asNamespace("MultiScholaR")
stopifnot(identical(normalizePath(getNamespaceInfo(ns,"path")),normalizePath(file.path(member$library$path,"MultiScholaR"))))
receipt <- list(status="starting",member=member,plan_sha256=sha(args[[1L]]))
path <- file.path(member$root,"member-launch.json")
stopifnot(!file.exists(path))
tryCatch({
    config <- get("launchWorkflowApplication",ns)(member$root,diagnostic=FALSE,mode="adapters",test_root=repo)
    receipt$status <- "launched"
    receipt$config <- config
},error=function(error){receipt$status<<-"failed";receipt$error<<-conditionMessage(error)},
finally=jsonlite::write_json(receipt,path,auto_unbox=TRUE,pretty=TRUE))
if (receipt$status != "launched") stop(receipt$error)

args <- commandArgs(TRUE)
source <- file.path(args[[1L]], "R/utils_workflow_dia_qc_rollup.R")
helper <- file.path(args[[2L]], "tests/testthat/helper-workflow-bulk-rollup.R")
extract <- function(path, name) {
    code <- parse(path, keep.source = TRUE)
    for (i in seq_along(code)) {
        expr <- code[[i]]
        if (is.call(expr) && identical(expr[[1L]], as.name("<-")) &&
            identical(expr[[2L]], as.name(name))) return(list(expr = expr, span = attr(code,"srcref")[[i]]))
    }
    stop("missing frozen control function")
}
control <- extract(helper,"computeWFXNativeFilterControl")$expr
control[[2L]] <- as.name("computeDIAReferenceSampleFilter")
old <- extract(source,"computeDIAReferenceSampleFilter")
lines <- readLines(source)
lines <- c(lines[seq_len(old$span[[1L]]-1L)], deparse(control, width.cutoff=100L),
    if (old$span[[3L]] < length(lines)) lines[seq.int(old$span[[3L]]+1L,length(lines))])
# Only the control invokes explicit accepted P14 without the new admission-estimate query.
text <- paste(lines, collapse="\n")
needle <- 'computeDIARelationalRollup(manager$.context$store, input, persist, profile = "P14", worker_cap = worker_cap)'
stopifnot(length(gregexpr(needle,text,fixed=TRUE)[[1L]]) == 1L, grepl(needle,text,fixed=TRUE))
text <- sub(needle, 'computeDIARelationalRollup(manager$.context$store, input, persist, profile = "P14", worker_cap = NULL)', text,fixed=TRUE)
writeLines(text,source)
invisible(parse(source))
